scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @conciliacao/core build && pnpm --filter @conciliacao/runtime build && pnpm --filter @conciliacao/web dev
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:components && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:parity && pnpm test:legacy
